match.reason: The bank point teaches special journals (sales, purchases and cash journals) for credit and cash transactions, while the new point teaches the general journal, which records the wider range of transactions such as returns, drawings, advertising stock, owner contributions and corrections, so it is related but not the same idea.

draft.title: The general journal
card: The general journal is the book of original entry. Each transaction is recorded here first, in date order, before it goes to the ledger. Each entry shows the date, the accounts debited and credited, the amounts and a short narration.

Not every transaction has its own special journal in Unit 3, so all kinds are shown as general journal entries. These include cash and credit sales and purchases, returns, drawings, stock used for advertising, assets the owner contributes and corrections.
Drawings are stock or cash the owner takes for personal use. Debit Drawings, credit Cash at Bank or Inventory. Stock used for advertising is debited to Advertising and credited to Inventory.
A correction is a new entry that fixes an earlier mistake. It reverses the wrong accounts and records the right ones. The original entry is not erased.
draft.remember: Journal first, ledger second: every transaction and every correction is a dated entry with equal debits and credits.

a.q: Priya owns a shoe shop. She takes a pair of shoes from inventory for her own use. Which journal entry records this?
opts: Debit Drawings, credit Inventory
Debit Inventory, credit Drawings
Debit Advertising, credit Inventory
Debit Drawings, credit Capital
a.why: Taking stock for personal use is drawings, so Drawings is debited and Inventory, an asset that falls, is credited. Debit Advertising is tempting, but that is for stock used to promote the business, not for the owner's personal use.
a.clue: Who benefits from the shoes, the business or the owner?

b.q: Leo's Cycles debited Repairs Expense instead of Advertising Expense for a $200 poster bill paid by cash at bank. How is this fixed in the journal?
opts: Debit Advertising Expense, credit Repairs Expense
Debit Repairs Expense, credit Advertising Expense
Debit Advertising Expense, credit Cash at Bank
Erase the original entry and write it again
b.why: The wrong expense was debited, so it must be credited to cancel it, and the right expense is debited. Crediting Cash at Bank would pay the bill a second time, since cash was already paid correctly. The original entry stays, and a new entry corrects it.
b.clue: Cash was right. Only the expense account was wrong.

b.best: Debit Advertising Expense, credit Repairs Expense

problems.detail: "Not every transaction has its own special journal in Unit 3" implies some Unit 3 transactions do have special journals. Under the 2025 Study Design, the general journal is used for every transaction (the chapter point says so), so this line could mislead students. Something like "In Unit 3, every transaction is recorded in the general journal" would be clearer.

check.summary: Both questions have one clearly correct answer, and the entries for drawings, stock used for advertising and the correction are accurate. The only issue is a card line that wrongly suggests some Unit 3 transactions have special journals, when the general journal is used for all of them.
